tools.name: rentecdirect_ping
tools.description: Check that the API key works. Returns the Rentec Direct user id and company the key belongs to. Rentec Direct API: GET /ping.

tools.name: rentecdirect_list_properties
tools.description: List properties with address, rent, deposit, owner and occupancy. Filter to occupied or vacant properties. Rentec Direct API: GET /properties.

tools.name: rentecdirect_get_property
tools.description: Get one property by its integer id, including its renters and subunits. Rentec Direct API: GET /properties/{id}.

tools.name: rentecdirect_list_tenants
tools.description: List tenants with contact details and balance. Requires the read:tenants permission. Rentec Direct API: GET /tenants.

tools.name: rentecdirect_get_tenant
tools.description: Get one tenant by its id (renter_id), including properties and balance. Rentec Direct API: GET /tenants/{id}.

tools.name: rentecdirect_list_leases
tools.description: List leases with move-in and move-out dates, lease term, recurring rent and balances. Rentec Direct API: GET /leases.

tools.name: rentecdirect_get_lease
tools.description: Get one lease by its id (lease_id). Rentec Direct API: GET /leases/{id}.

tools.name: rentecdirect_list_work_orders
tools.description: List maintenance work orders with status, property, vendor, priority and cost. Status codes: OpenU (unassigned), OpenA (assigned), Parts, Work, Finalized, Closed. Rentec Direct API: GET /work_orders.

tools.name: rentecdirect_get_work_order
tools.description: Get one work order by its id (workorder_id), with notes. Rentec Direct API: GET /work_orders/{id}.

tools.name: rentecdirect_list_transactions
tools.description: List ledger transactions (payments, charges, expenses) with amount, category, property and date. Results are paged, 300 per page. Rentec Direct API: GET /transactions.

tools.name: rentecdirect_list_owners
tools.description: List property owners with contact details and balance. Rentec Direct API: GET /owners.

tools.name: rentecdirect_get_owner
tools.description: Get one owner by its id (owner_id). Rentec Direct API: GET /owners/{id}.

tools.name: rentecdirect_list_vendors
tools.description: List vendors (contractors and service providers) with contact details and rate. Rentec Direct API: GET /vendors.

tools.name: rentecdirect_get_vendor
tools.description: Get one vendor by its id (vendor_id). Rentec Direct API: GET /vendors/{id}.

tools.name: rentecdirect_create_work_order
tools.description: Create a maintenance work order for a property. This writes a new record to the account. Optional: tenant, vendor, status, priority 1-5, cost. Does not send e-mail. Rentec Direct API: POST /work_orders.
